notes:
Derived from the compound verb ⟦{跳|は}ね{返|かえ}す→跳ね返す：30745_hanekaesu⟧ (to bounce back, to repel). The noun form covers both the action of bouncing back and devices designed to prevent splashing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {跳|は}ね{返|かえ}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧ — strong rebound/bounce
- ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{跳|は}ね{返|かえ}し — water splashback
- ⟦{油|あぶら}→油：01693_abura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{跳|は}ね{返|かえ}し — oil splatter
- ⟦{泥|どろ}→泥：03492_doro⟧{跳|は}ね{返|かえ}し — mudflap; mud guard

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{反発|はんぱつ}→反発：08676_hanpatsu⟧ — repulsion; rebound (more abstract or scientific)
- ⟦{跳|は}ね{返|かえ}す→跳ね返す：30745_hanekaesu⟧ — to bounce back; to repel (the verb form)
- ⟦{飛|と}び{散|ち}り→飛び散る：09645_tobichiru⟧ — scattering; spattering
